title: Filter Lineage Search by Project
summary: The Data Lineage API now allows developers to filter `searchLineageStreaming` results by specific projects, enabling more targeted and efficient lineage queries.
details: The `GoogleCloudDatacatalogLineageV1SearchLineageStreamingRequestSearchFilters` schema has been enhanced with a new `projects` property. This optional array of strings accepts project IDs (e.g., `projects/my-project`) or project numbers (e.g., `projects/123456789`). When provided, lineage links will be restricted to the specified projects, offering a significant improvement for managing and querying lineage in multi-project environments.
